adapter-entry-point.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and clean canonical Codex Provider Entry Point generation

interactive-only-boundary.method: Repository contract tests prove the exact adapter and bespoke mirror refuse headless, autonomous, scheduled, background, batch, CI, and missing-user-presence invocation before reads or writes

explicit-user-judgment.method: The shared resolver authority guard rejects missing and agent-authored authority and accepts only explicit current-user --by user selection before Decision Item access

auditable-resolution.method: Repository contract tests bind every close to scripts/ops/resolve-decision.ts --by user and its resolution metadata plus decision_resolved journal audit

validated-status-transition.method: Repository contract tests require status-changing resolutions to complete through scripts/ops/update-entity-status.ts transition validation and status_change audit before the Decision Item is closed

provider-semantic-equivalence.method: Compared the exact Codex and Claude adapters with issue #60, parent #46, accepted blockers #47/#48, the Decision Item model, the decisions workflow, and approved repository operations

eligible-environment.method: The configured interactive Trade Journal runtime completed non-mutating operation preflight and credential-free authority-guard tests on 2026-08-12; sandbox, database, or user-presence absence remains refused or unavailable
